what: Prompts and a hand answer key for probe D: can the identity call rank the six abilities? (Fable 5.2, 2026-11-14.) "expect.high" must not come back low and "expect.low" must not come back high; "expect.attacksOn" lists the abilities it is fair for the attacks to key on. "model" is the printed creature to tell the call about in arm 2; null means the creature resembles nothing. Judged on the modal answer across rolls.

the Medusa is quick and commanding, not strong
a cunning, magnetic captain; INT 4 was the complaint

prompts.note: a hag is strong and shrewd
